new: No annual count exists yet (Art. 115 bis): each register is given the census population of the territorial States attached to its people.
The plenary majority depends on seventy individual votes and is not modelled here.

The formula is left to confederal law. Here: fiscal capacity is GDP per inhabitant (Eurostat 2023, PPS); the average is weighted by population over the 52 States; one uniform rate is levied on the surplus, the lowest that pays the floor.
At this setting the ceiling does not pay for the floor. The text does not say who covers the gap.
The text does not say how the limits combine with the method. Here: one common divisor, standard rounding, then the limits, as on the portal.
Two thirds is rounded up: seven of the ten members of a delegation, 167 of the 250 delegates. A majority of the fourteen members of the committee is eight.
